note: Evaluation material only. Never an auditor input and never part of a telemetry export. Arithmetic is independent of application code.

findings.suggested_action: Switch off the Room A light when the room is vacant (fixture uses a zero-second grace period).
findings.assumptions: Zero-second grace is fixture-only; real deployments use the configured vacancy grace period.
findings.resolution_limit: One-minute intervals; sub-minute occupancy or switching events are not visible.

explicit_non_findings.reason: Always-on exception: vacant operation is by design, so no vacant-but-on finding is raised.

rounding_budget.note: Exported kWh values carry up to 12 decimal places; internal accumulation is unrounded. This budget bounds the worst case of summing per-value-rounded exports.

fractional_power_check.note: Exported power carries up to 9 decimals, energy up to 12. Stored energy derives from unrounded power, never from rounded display power.
